title: X20: AppPreferences double-create race across processes/devices

description: The normalize tie-break is nondeterministic on identical singletonID rows, causing an observable flip-flop that can reopen after appearing resolved. Severity: Medium. Wave/Plan: Wave 5, plan 5a mutation-scope-discipline (Wave 6 plan 6a adds an additional flip-flop stress test building on this fix - not a separate finding). Sweep: cross-process.
